scope: Read-only inventory classification; not complete product/hardware parity

protocol_mapping_reference.usage: protocol facts only, no copied implementation

capability_limits: No Classic TX or physical commissioning
No new code path writes EMS+ controls on unknown/Classic/conflicting family
No gas-meter or independent flame claim
Unmapped rows remain visible work, not silently supported
Source freshness uses 64-bit local monotone receive time; not proof of physical sensor age
Gateway diagnostics are transport status, not boiler fields
